scope: Catalog reconciliation: remaining distinct cast-exclusive and boss/raid skill gaps

records.name: Bloody Sauce
records.effect: Fires scattered purple Ki blasts that can poison or slow the opponent; Crystal Raid/Training availability is separately documented.

records.name: Celestial Hammer
records.effect: Fused Zamasu charges and slams the opponent with a fist, sending them flying.

records.name: Giant Storm
records.effect: Creates a large tracking explosion beneath the opponent.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.effect: Grab attack followed by a Ki Wave slam; leaves the user open.

records.name: Spiral of Condemnation
records.effect: Releases three energy spirals toward the opponent.

notes: Cleaned to retain only identities not already covered by prior research batches. Marbling Drop, Seasoning Arrow, Time Shackles, and Flames of Retribution were already documented in batch 264 and are therefore excluded here. Peeler Storm was likewise excluded because it is already covered in batch 264.
